### God’s Angels
Author: N. R. Gillogly
Site: The Upper Room
URL: https://www.upperroom.org/devotionals/en-2026-06-23
Passage: Exodus 23:20
Points:
- After recovering from hip replacement surgery, the author faced physical limitations and could not handle daily tasks alone.
- Friends stepped in to offer practical support, assisting with grocery shopping and mobility.
- God often uses ordinary people in our lives as His earthly messengers and protectors along the way.
- Believers are encouraged to discern the needs of those around them and serve as God's helping hands.
